title: Patina Miller Thinks Raquel Thomas Should Have Spinoff Of Raising Kanan
htmlContent:
Miller was on The Crew Has It Podcast with Michael Rainey Jr. and Gianni Paolo. During the appearance Miller shared that she would be in support of a Spinoff of Raising Kanan focus on Thomas younger self.

“She needs it,” said Miller.

“There’s so much to unpack from her running with who she was running with at 15, being caught up with an undercover cop, dealing with two of the top kingpins, being up under them, and then learning all she needs to know from them, and then doing her own thing, being the woman in charge."

She added, “That would be interesting as f***,” Rainey shared, musing the project could be titled Raising Raq. “Yeah, Raising Raq, baby!” “Come on, Sascha,” refencing to Sascha Penn, who is the creator of Raising Kanan series.
